description:
Change a finished video against its selected base_version. Included revision rounds apply (no credits). Name output_id for one hook/Short/format. Exact supported changes use apply_edits or fix_captions. To replace retained main scratch narration, check check_video.narration.can_change and pass explicit voice plus 'Change narrator to Brian. Keep the script and edit.' (use the selected name). This preserves script/edit/assets; send other edits separately. That replacement path refuses uploaded speech, silent motion and mixed voice/visual instructions. To ADD narration to an existing silent main motion video, keep voice omitted and begin change with 'Narrator: liam
Narration: <exact one-line voiceover script>
<visual and sound-effect revision notes>'. Use a catalog narrator name. This addition supports creative notes in the same round, rebuilds visuals on the recorded narration word clock, and refuses mismatched, clipped or missing voiceover. Preserve operation_id/arguments on retries; use a new operation_id for a deliberate new change and check its resulting version.

dry_run.description: true: say what the change uses and send nothing.

operation_id.description: A stable ID for this authorized request. Preserve it on retries. Use a new ID only for a deliberate new request.

output_id.description: Change only this output (a hook, a Short or a format) from check_video.

voice.description: The narrator for a video made from words: matilda, sarah, jessica, alice, liam, chris, brian, george, roger, laura, charlie, river, will, eric, bella, daniel, lily, bill, adam, callum, harry (sarah: calm, reassuring, health and money; alice: a clear British educator; brian: deep documentary; liam: energetic ads). Leave out to let Clypmint pick one that fits the words. "Voice: <name>" in instructions does the same.

name: revise_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint revise_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Request a video change
